scripts.dev: npm run typecheck && concurrently --kill-others --names types,api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,magenta "tsc -b --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run api:serve" "npm run web:serve"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm run build:artifacts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:artifacts
scripts.build:artifacts: npm run web:bundle && npm run desktop:bundle
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.api:dev: npm run typecheck && concurrently --kill-others --names types,api --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "tsc -b --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run api:serve"
scripts.api:start: npm run api:build && npm --workspace @dglab-pulse-hub/api run start
scripts.web:dev: npm run typecheck && concurrently --kill-others --names types,web --prefix-colors yellow,magenta "tsc -b --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run web:serve"
scripts.web:build: npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:bundle
scripts.web:preview: npm run web:build && vite preview --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.desktop:bundle: npm run desktop:assets && npm run desktop:main && npm run desktop:preload && npm run desktop:renderer
scripts.desktop:build: npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:bundle
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:start
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:clean && npm --workspace @dglab-pulse-hub/desktop run package
scripts.desktop:make: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:clean && npm --workspace @dglab-pulse-hub/desktop run make
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose logs --follow api web nginx
